name: Abbeville County Courthouse
unique: A neoclassical courthouse on the square where the secession movement organized, with a Confederate monument and a lawn of old oaks.
buzz: The square is the walk and the courthouse is the anchor. Pair it with the opera house.

name: Fairfield County Courthouse
unique: An 1820s courthouse remodeled in the 1930s, on a wide main street of antebellum houses and a clock tower, in a town laid out in 1768.
buzz: A quick stop on the Winnsboro walk. The scale of the main street is the surprise.

name: Oakley Park
unique: An 1820s house museum with original outbuildings and grounds, tied to the governors and cotton planters who shaped Edgefield.
buzz: Tours are by appointment and the guides know the family history. Call before driving over.

name: Union County Courthouse
unique: A 1913 neoclassical courthouse with columns and a dome, on a main street of Victorian storefronts built by the textile mills.
buzz: The building is the best architecture in town and the square is quiet. Pair it with the county museum.
